item.title: Gangs
item.description: Are a crucial aspect of Azartnya Fortuna. In this district there are 7 major gangs.

item.title: Infusion
item.description: Is a ROMOURED process with which a soul of a powerful entity merges with a humanoid.

item.title: Titanar Aljiussu
item.description: Is a Nymph infused with the soul of a high fey.

item.title: Dusha Waiba
item.description: Titanar Aljiussu is a blunt and thuggish man who is not afraid of openly criticizing other people’s shortcomings to their faces, be it his equals (like his oath brothers, Titanar Aljiussu and Yudif Shinya), his subordinates or even his superiors.

item.title: Yudif Shinya
item.description: He is the Revered Father of the House of the church of Ilmatar, being the leader of the church and its attached monastery.

item.title: Crowned Scales
item.description: This is gang is mainly made out of draconic members. With its leader being Titanar Aljiussu.

item.title: Amora Mentira
item.description: Personality Reina is a kind and caring woman who considers Lando Lordo and Hero as friends.

item.title: Order of Munan Chohept Onast
item.description: The Order of Munan Chohept Onast is an organization in Volnygorod under the facade of a religion wherein disciples are unknowingly conned and brainwashed to forget about those important to them so that they could easily be manipulated.

item.title: The order
item.description: The order is a secret cult that is based on ancient knowledge, they take up kids and indoctrinate them into it.
